data.action: Enable Structured Task Results and review this PR.
steps: If the dashboard is open, press q to close it.
If the editor has unsent text, save a copy and leave the box empty.
In the editor, run /settings. Under Tasks → Subagents, turn on Structured Task Results; it applies now.
Press Esc, then Alt+B; select this PR and press s to retry the slay.
